description.value: On the Run is a Chevron-affiliated convenience store and fuel station on Industrial Road in West Kelowna. It combines a full convenience store with an on-site restaurant, making it a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through the area. The location also offers washrooms and a tire air station.
